links.comparator_used: Uniform fibrinogen monitoring of all patients (decision-curve analysis of model-guided monitoring against default monitoring strategies)
links.outcome: Net benefit of monitoring-intensity stratification for fibrinogen deterioration (decline of at least 50% from baseline and/or nadir below 1.5 g/L) during tigecycline therapy
links.effect: Decision-curve analysis favored model-guided monitoring at prespecified threshold probabilities after recalibration. Optimism-corrected AUCs were 0.755 (development), 0.731 (external validation) and 0.714 (prospective validation); the AUC was 0.693 in the full prospective eligible cohort (N=319). No net-benefit figures were given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Discrimination attenuated in the full prospective cohort (AUC 0.693). Calibration drift meant local recalibration was needed before implementation or threshold-based use in new settings.
links.quote: After recalibration, decision-curve analysis favored model-guided monitoring at prespecified threshold probabilities.
